name: RC-B10-0476/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns Russian attacks on civilian ships in the Black Sea, off Bulgaria and Romania, which have killed and injured crew members. It asks the European Union to help protect shipping, set up a Black Sea maritime security centre in Constanța and Varna, and support rescue efforts, sanctions and food export routes.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; it is a set of requests and condemnations, not new law.
- **Who it affects:** Bulgaria, Romania, seafarers, shipping companies and countries that import Ukrainian grain.
- **What happens next:** The EU Commission, Council and NATO are asked to act on naval protection, funding and sanctions.
